# Contributing

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](CONTRIBUTING.vi.md)

Open a concise PR with tests and evidence. Keep source changes around 600 diff lines or fewer per commit, except long bilingual documentation. Each modified EN/VI document pair must keep mutual language-switch links. Distinguish tested runtime evidence from proposed changes. Do not rewrite upstream license claims.
